title: Petition of Massachusetts Electric Company for a determination by the Department that certain electric 23 kV transmission lines in the City of Beverly between the Petitioner's underground circuit #2361 in McPherson Drive and the Petitioner's Balch Street substation, including the associated underground tap facilities, are necessary to provide a backup supply of electricity and enable the Petitioner to furnish reliable electric service to its customers in that part of the City of Beverly supplied from the Balch Street substation, and will serve the public convenience and be consistent with the public interest, and for said Department to authorize the petitioner to construct and use said line.
petitioner: Massachusetts Electric Company d/b/a National Grid
